note: Questions with fixed answers and stand-in pages written for this measure. The pages are not copies of real sites; scores on them are measured on stand-ins only.

questions.q: At what temperature does water boil at sea level in Celsius?
questions.title: Boiling point of water
questions.fact: At sea level, pure water boils at 100 degrees Celsius.

questions.q: What is the chemical symbol for gold?
questions.title: Gold (element)
questions.fact: Gold is a chemical element with the symbol Au, from the Latin word aurum.

questions.q: How many planets are in the Solar System?
questions.title: Solar System planets
questions.fact: Since 2006 the Solar System has been counted as having eight planets.

questions.q: What is the speed of light in a vacuum?
questions.title: Speed of light
questions.fact: Light in a vacuum travels at exactly 299,792,458 metres per second.

questions.q: Who wrote Pride and Prejudice?
questions.title: Pride and Prejudice
questions.fact: Pride and Prejudice is a novel by Jane Austen, first published in 1813.

questions.q: Which is the largest planet in the Solar System?
questions.title: Largest planet
questions.fact: Jupiter is the largest planet orbiting the Sun, more massive than all the others combined.

questions.q: What is the capital city of Australia?
questions.title: Australia capital
questions.fact: The capital of Australia is Canberra, chosen as a compromise between Sydney and Melbourne.

questions.q: In what year did Apollo 11 land on the Moon?
questions.title: Apollo 11
questions.fact: Apollo 11 landed on the Moon on 20 July 1969.

questions.q: What is the atomic number of carbon?
questions.title: Carbon
questions.fact: Carbon has the atomic number 6, so each atom holds six protons.

questions.q: Which is the longest river in Africa?
questions.title: Rivers of Africa
questions.fact: The Nile is the longest river in Africa, flowing north into the Mediterranean Sea.

questions.q: Who painted the Mona Lisa?
questions.title: Mona Lisa
questions.fact: The Mona Lisa was painted by Leonardo da Vinci in the early sixteenth century.

questions.q: What is the freezing point of water in Fahrenheit?
questions.title: Freezing point of water
questions.fact: Water freezes at 32 degrees Fahrenheit, which is zero on the Celsius scale.

questions.q: How many bones are in the adult human body?
questions.title: Human skeleton
questions.fact: A typical adult human skeleton is made up of 206 bones.

questions.q: What is the chemical formula of table salt?
questions.title: Table salt
questions.fact: Table salt is sodium chloride, written with the formula NaCl.

questions.q: What is the smallest prime number?
questions.title: Prime numbers
questions.fact: The smallest prime number is 2, and it is also the only even prime.

questions.q: Who developed the theory of general relativity?
questions.title: General relativity
questions.fact: General relativity was published by Albert Einstein in 1915.

questions.q: What is the capital of Japan?
questions.title: Japan capital
questions.fact: Tokyo is the capital of Japan and its largest city.

questions.q: What is the hardest natural mineral?
questions.title: Mineral hardness
questions.fact: Diamond is the hardest natural mineral, rated 10 on the Mohs scale.

questions.q: How many sides does a hexagon have?
questions.title: Hexagon
questions.fact: A hexagon is a flat shape with six sides and six corners.

questions.q: Who wrote Romeo and Juliet?
questions.title: Romeo and Juliet
questions.fact: Romeo and Juliet is a tragedy written by William Shakespeare.

questions.q: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
questions.title: Oceans of the world
questions.fact: The Pacific is the largest and deepest of the world's oceans.

questions.q: What is the value of pi to two decimal places?
questions.title: Pi
questions.fact: Rounded to two decimal places, pi is 3.14.

questions.q: Which gas do plants take in for photosynthesis?
questions.title: Photosynthesis
questions.fact: In photosynthesis, plants take in carbon dioxide and water and release oxygen.

questions.q: In what year did the Berlin Wall fall?
questions.title: Berlin Wall
questions.fact: The Berlin Wall fell on 9 November 1989.

questions.q: What is the chemical symbol for iron?
questions.title: Iron (element)
questions.fact: Iron has the chemical symbol Fe, from the Latin word ferrum.

questions.q: How many continents are there?
questions.title: Continents
questions.fact: By the most common count, there are seven continents.

questions.q: Who discovered penicillin?
questions.title: Penicillin
questions.fact: Penicillin was discovered by Alexander Fleming in 1928.

questions.q: What is the square root of 144?
questions.title: Square roots
questions.fact: The square root of 144 is 12, because 12 times 12 is 144.

questions.q: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.title: Mercury (planet)
questions.fact: Mercury is the planet closest to the Sun.

questions.q: What is the tallest mountain above sea level?
questions.title: Highest mountains
questions.fact: Mount Everest has the highest peak above sea level of any mountain on Earth.

questions.q: How many minutes are in one day?
questions.title: Units of time
questions.fact: One day has 24 hours, which is 1440 minutes.

questions.q: Who wrote On the Origin of Species?
questions.title: On the Origin of Species
questions.fact: On the Origin of Species was written by Charles Darwin and published in 1859.

questions.q: What is the capital of Canada?
questions.title: Canada capital
questions.fact: Ottawa, in the province of Ontario, is the capital of Canada.

questions.q: How many strings does a standard guitar have?
questions.title: Guitar
questions.fact: A standard guitar has six strings.

questions.q: What substance has the formula H2O?
questions.title: H2O
questions.fact: H2O is the chemical formula of water: two hydrogen atoms and one oxygen atom.

questions.q: In what year did the French Revolution begin?
questions.title: French Revolution
questions.fact: The French Revolution began in 1789 with the storming of the Bastille.

questions.q: How many hearts does an octopus have?
questions.title: Octopus
questions.fact: An octopus has three hearts: two pump blood to the gills and one to the body.

questions.q: Who created the first injected polio vaccine?
questions.title: Polio vaccine
questions.fact: The first injected polio vaccine was developed by Jonas Salk and announced in 1955.

questions.q: What is the capital of Kenya?
questions.title: Kenya capital
questions.fact: Nairobi is the capital and largest city of Kenya.

questions.q: Which planet is called the Red Planet?
questions.title: Red Planet
questions.fact: Mars is called the Red Planet because iron oxide on its surface looks red.

questions.q: What is the largest hot desert in the world?
questions.title: Deserts
questions.fact: The Sahara in North Africa is the largest hot desert in the world.

questions.q: How many degrees are in a right angle?
questions.title: Right angle
questions.fact: A right angle measures exactly 90 degrees.

questions.q: Which element has the symbol O?
questions.title: Element symbols
questions.fact: The symbol O stands for oxygen, element number 8.

questions.q: How many players does a football team have on the field?
questions.title: Association football
questions.fact: In association football each team has eleven players on the field, one of them the goalkeeper.

questions.q: Who composed the Moonlight Sonata?
questions.title: Moonlight Sonata
questions.fact: The Moonlight Sonata is a piano sonata by Ludwig van Beethoven, finished in 1801.
